instructions.text: Wash hands and clean a fingertip with an alcohol wipe.
Prick the fingertip with a lancet and wipe away the first drop.
Fill the white blood cell analyzer cuvette from the second drop.
Insert the cuvette into the HemoCue white cell analyzer and wait for the result.
Enter the result in the app.
Use the same finger-stick sample as the white blood cell count.
Read the lymphocyte value from the analyzer's differential result.
Enter the result in the app.
Measure at the same time of day, before eating, after using the toilet.
Wear the same light clothing as at baseline.
Sit on the body mass measurement device, hold still while it oscillates.
Enter the mass; the app converts it to percent change from pre-flight.
Sit upright with the elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Squeeze the grip-force sensor as hard as possible for 3 seconds.
Rest 30 seconds and repeat 3 times with each hand.
Enter the best value; the app converts it to percent change from pre-flight.
Sit with the head supported and look straight ahead.
A crewmate applies one anesthetic eye drop as trained.
Cover the tonometer tip with a fresh sterile cover.
Touch the tip lightly to the center of the cornea until it beeps; take 3 readings per eye.
Enter the average for each eye in the app.
Dim the lights and rest the chin and forehead on the OCT support.
Look at the fixation light without blinking while the operator centers the scan.
Capture the optic disc scan for each eye.
The app reads the retinal thickness and compares it with the pre-flight scan.
Dim the lights and position the head on the support.
Capture an OCT scan and a fundus image of each eye.
Check the image is in focus and the optic disc is centered; retake if not.
Save the images to the app; they are attached to the flight surgeon packet.
Lie still for 5 minutes wearing the Bio-Monitor shirt (or a blood pressure cuff).
Record lying blood pressure.
Stand up (or, in weightlessness, use the leg-pressure test as trained) and stay still.
Record blood pressure at 1 and 3 minutes; stop and sit if dizzy.
The app calculates the fall in systolic pressure.
Rest quietly for 5 minutes wearing the Bio-Monitor shirt.
Record the average heart rate over 1 minute.
Enter or sync the value in the app.
Lie on the left side and expose the chest.
Follow the guided ultrasound software to place the probe for a heart view.
Record 3 heart beats in the standard views.
The software estimates ejection fraction; save the clips to the app.
Wear the Bio-Monitor headband and shirt overnight.
On waking, confirm bedtime and wake time in the sleep diary.
The app averages the last 3 nights.
Find a quiet spot and silence alerts.
Open the cognition test on the station laptop or tablet.
Complete all tasks without stopping.
The app compares the score with your baseline.
Stand (or, in weightlessness, hold the posture task position) with feet together.
Follow the tablet balance task with eyes open, then eyes closed.
The app scores sway and compares it with your baseline.
Open the daily check-in in the app.
Rate mood, stress and how well the team is working, from 0 to 10.
Add a note if you want; answers are private to you and the medical team.
The app reads solar alerts relayed from NASA and NOAA and the onboard radiation monitors automatically.
Check your personal dosimeter is worn and logging.
Follow the shelter instructions shown by the app.
